thought.text:
Ketemu jawabannya. Saldo key itu **$0.7**, bukan $1.

Saya cek apakah saldonya **turun** setelah request — itu bukti dia benar-benar memotong.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && timeout 240 python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request,subprocess,time
OB=subprocess.check_output("grep -oE 'sk-obs1_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+' ob_ready.txt | head -1",shell=True,text=True).strip()
def bal():
    r=urllib.request.Request("https://obscurify.ai/get_user_balance",headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {OB}"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=30) as x: return json.load(x)['balance']
b0=bal(); print(f"saldo awal        : ${b0}")
sysmsg="You are Hermes, a helpful personal AI agent. "*60
b=json.dumps({"model":"deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored",
  "messages":[{"role":"system","content":sysmsg},{"role":"user","content":"Jelaskan fotosintesis."}],"max_tokens":300}).encode()
r=urllib.request.Request("https://obscurify.ai/v1/chat/completions",data=b,
  headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {OB}","Content-Type":"application/json"})
with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=120) as x: d=json.load(x)
print(f"cost dilaporkan   : ${d['usage']['cost']:.6f}")
time.sleep(2)
b1=bal(); print(f"saldo sesudah      : ${b1}")
print(f"selisih            : ${b0-b1:.6f}")
print()
print(f"=> sisa pesan dgn saldo ${b1}: {int(b1/max(b0-b1,1e-9)):,}")
PY
